children: Bitcoin
backers got real policy wins from President
Donald Trump
, including a landmark stablecoin law, but his own financial ties now threaten the legislation the industry still needs.
Trump courted the industry hard on the campaign trail, pledging at Nashville’s
to make America the “crypto capital of the planet” and
SEC Chair
Gary Gensler
, who later announced his departure effective January 20, 2025.
Markets responded immediately: Bitcoin crossed $100,000 by early December and touched roughly $109,000 just before inauguration, a gain of about 44.6% from election night’s high.
What Trump’s Administration Actually Delivered
GENIUS Act
(July 2025), establishing a federal framework for payment stablecoins
Coinbase
case (February 2025) and rescinded SAB 121 custody accounting guidance
Strategic Bitcoin Reserve established (March 2025)
, capitalized initially with forfeited Bitcoin
DeFi broker rule overturned (April 2025), reversing an IRS reporting requirement
Banking access eased through OCC guidance letting national banks engage with crypto more freely
SEC approved simpler listing standards for qualifying crypto investment funds (September 2025), making new products easier to bring to market.
Why the CLARITY Act Exposes the Limits of His Support
The Senate’s procedural vote to advance the CLARITY Act fell short 49-50 on Sept. 15, leaving the bill stalled rather than dead.
Paradigm senior adviser
Justin Slaughter
told Bloomberg, as Benzinga reported, that “the failure of Clarity begins and ends with Donald Trump.”
Even Trump-aligned investor
Nic Carter
criticized the president’s family business interests for complicating negotiations.
The dispute split along familiar lines:
Sen.
Elizabeth Warren
(D-Mass.): argued the bill didn’t adequately prevent presidential self-dealing
Sens.
Cynthia Lummis
(R-Wyo.),
John Boozman
(R-Ark.),
Tim Scott
(R-S.C.): said the revised bill had incorporated most of a bipartisan ethics proposal already
Trump’s own crypto ventures, including a memecoin launched days before his inauguration and his family’s stake in
World Liberty Financial
(CRYPTO: WLFI), gave Democrats a concrete target to point to throughout the fight.
Other Costs Tied to Trump’s Involvement
Benzinga reported that roughly 989,000 TRUMP token wallets sat underwater, with estimated losses near $3.81 billion.
Meanwhile, Trump’s October 2025 China tariff threat triggered a selloff with roughly $19 billion in leveraged liquidations across crypto.
He also pardoned Binance founder
Changpeng Zhao
in October 2025, following Zhao’s conviction for failing to maintain anti-money-laundering controls.
What the Midterms Could Change
Reuters reported October 13 that Democrats are preparing investigations into Trump-family crypto and prediction-market ties if they retake either chamber.
A Democratic win wouldn’t repeal GENIUS or dissolve the Bitcoin reserve, since those gains came through law and executive order rather than anything Congress alone controls.
But it would hand Democrats subpoena power and committee leverage, making any future CLARITY-style bill even harder to pass without addressing the ethics concerns that sank it this time.

title: Trump Gave Crypto What It Wanted: Is He Also Its Biggest Problem?
